scope: AQA Physics 7408 Year 1/AS sections 3.4.1.3 (motion graphs), 3.4.2.1–3.4.2.2 (materials), 3.5.1.5 (potential dividers) and 3.5.1.6 (emf and internal resistance). Targeted application and graphic interpretation, not a complete AS spec audit.

priorEvidence.finding: Nine selected partial evidence rows were recorded at v153. Follow-on v158, v194, v197 and v200 had already supplied circuit, signed-motion, projectiles and internal-resistance original practice; the remaining most direct weakness was curved s–t tangent evidence plus nonlinear force-extension comparison.

Existing v197 velocity-time reversal and raised-platform projectile questions avoid duplicating same old data; v203 adds curved displacement-time tangent, acceleration-time area and non-proportional materials response.

Potential dividers, NTC and LDR, and loaded divider already have recall and one simple example. v203 extends to loaded branch-current comparisons, two sensor placements and power-accounted internal-resistance graphs.
v200 verified emf/intercept/gradient error bars and independent numerical calculations; v203 separates electrical losses and battery energy.
